architecture_selection.reference_feature_family: The core T1 feature set is selected using Logistic Regression on DEVELOPMENT folds before CatBoost promotion.
architecture_selection.simpler_tie_breaker: If macro AP gain over the immediately simpler set is < 0.002 absolute, retain the simpler set unless Lift@10% improves by >=0.10x with no Brier degradation >0.003.
architecture_selection.asked_visit_sensitivity: D_WITHOUT may remove asked_visit only if macro AP improves by >=0.005 OR WITH_ASKED_VISIT shows a systematic calibration/segment failure. Otherwise retain the valid contemporaneous signal.
architecture_selection.selected_spot_context: E is challenger-only. Even if E scores better, it does not redefine LeadQuality core; any incremental benefit is reported for later Opportunity/Inventory integration.

promote_over_logistic_if_all: CatBoost AP is >= Logistic AP in at least 3 of 4 development folds OR macro paired-bootstrap P(delta_AP>0) >= 0.80
no systematic material collapse in a segment with N >= 100: AP delta < -0.03 in the same segment across >=2 eligible folds OR Brier delta > +0.02 across >=2 eligible folds
incremental gain is operationally meaningful: macro delta AP >= 0.005 OR macro delta Lift@10% >= 0.10x
catboost_promotion.otherwise: Logistic Regression remains champion; simplicity wins ties and inconclusive comparisons.

calibration.selection: Choose calibrated method only if 5-fold calibration-OOF Brier OR Log Loss improves over raw without worsening the other metric by >0.005 absolute. If improvements are tied within 0.001, prefer Platt over isotonic and raw over either if neither materially improves.

procedural_holdout.may_open_only_after: FROZEN_MODEL_CONFIG.json exists with status=FROZEN and immutable hashes/config
procedural_holdout.post_result_model_changes: Only documented bug/leakage/methodological inconsistency; holdout then remains consumed.
